nodes.label: Smart Life Edition Spec
nodes.rationale: for TestFlight and own use only, never the App Store, because Smart Life is reached through the sign-in Home Assistant's Tuya integration uses rather than a Tuya API offered to apps.

nodes.label: HouseSmartLife Module Linkage
nodes.rationale: Only this edition links HouseSmartLife, and build-ios.sh refuses an App Store archive that contains it, so the unsupported Tuya path cannot leak into the App Store build.

nodes.label: Separate Bundle ID and App Group
nodes.rationale: The Smart Life edition is its own app with io.github.0xprobabillity.HouseControl and its own App Group, so both editions can sit on one iPhone without mixing their widgets.

nodes.label: Photo-Library Usage Description for Sign-In Code
nodes.rationale: The sign-in code must be scanned by the Smart Life app on the very phone in hand, so the code is saved to Photos and scanned from there; the usage description states exactly that.
